'''The Rock''' is a small Alliance outpost located off the coast of [[Lapidis Isle]]. Consisting of a tent and a cannon stand, the outpost is manned by two members of the [[Kul Tiran Exploratory Fleet]] and serves to blast any unwanted ships. The Rock is seen as a boring shift by the Caelan's Rest marines.
